job.job_description:
Eduzent is looking for Backend devloper to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
Backend Development:Design, develop, and maintain server-side logic for high-performance and scalable applications
Implement APIs and integrate with front-end components to deliver a seamless user experience
Database Management:Design and optimize database schemas for efficient data storage and retrieval
Collaborate with database administrators to ensure database performance, security, and reliability
API Development:Develop and maintain RESTful APIs to enable seamless communication between front-end and back-end systems
Implement secure and well-documented APIs for internal and external consumption
Code Optimization:Optimize backend code for performance, scalability, and maintainability
Conduct regular code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards
Security:Implement security best practices to protect against common web application vulnerabilities
Collaborate with security teams to conduct regular security assessments and implement necessary measures
Collaboration:Work closely with front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including QA engineers and product managers, to deliver high-quality software
Testing:Implement unit tests and participate in the development of automated testing processes
Troubleshoot and debug issues reported by the QA team and users
Documentation:Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for backend code, APIs, and database schemas
Document coding standards and best practices for the development team
